title: bug: launcher identity probes fold \\wsl$ / \\wsl.localhost project paths as plain UNC, unlike the shared path contract
description:
Follow-up split from task-25ba449ab87d4039a283426f07302cbc (planned 2026-10-30 by architect-bd1eb82d). That task makes packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts comparableProjectPath the shared project-path contract. The daemon twin and JetBrains DaemonIdentityProbe.comparableProjectPath follow it. Under the contract, a WSL share (\\wsl$\<distro>\x or \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\x, host in any ASCII case, distro not compared) names that distro's POSIX /x. The POSIX and /mnt/<d> rules then apply to it.

The launchers do not do this. moe-agent.sh probe_daemon_health comparable() (ntpath) and moe-agent.ps1 Get-MoeComparableProjectPath treat the share as a generic UNC path and lowercase it: //wsl$/ubuntu/home/u/p. Checked by the architect on 2026-10-30 with python3 and PS5.1 over the contract rows: the launchers agree on every row except the 4 WSL-share rows.

Effects:
- The documented setup in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md is JetBrains on Windows opening \\wsl$\Ubuntu\..., with the daemon in WSL serving /home/u/p. There, a native Windows ps1 seat refuses its own daemon with MOE_DAEMON_FOREIGN_PROJECT.
- \\wsl$\Ubuntu\x and \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\x name the same share, yet they compare as foreign.

task-25ba449a adds path-contract tests to scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs. They mark the launchers' WSL-share rows todo and name this task. This task turns them into hard assertions.

Not in scope (decide separately):
- scripts/local-runner/guest-session.mjs canonicalProjectPath. Its key names persisted VM ledger dirs, so changing the key needs a migration decision.
- JetBrains' two exotic deviations from the contract: it reads ///x as UNC, and it treats \ as a separator inside POSIX paths.
definitionOfDone: moe-agent.sh comparable() and moe-agent.ps1 Get-MoeComparableProjectPath map \\wsl$\<distro>\… and \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\… (host matched in any ASCII case, distro not compared, share root = /) to the POSIX remainder, then apply the POSIX and /mnt/<d> rules. Every path-contract row gets the same key as moe-proxy comparableProjectPath.
The launchers' WSL-share rows in the daemon-json-cap.test.mjs path-contract tests are hard assertions (no todo) and pass on bash, PS5.1 and PS7. Every existing identity row still passes.
bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes, and moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM.

implementationPlan.description: Tests first using mem:gotcha-powershell-path-comparison-culture. In scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs turn only this task's launcher WSL-share todos into normal assertions (keep legitimate unavailable-engine skips, but require native Windows evidence). Extend WSL_SHARES with both host aliases and mixed ASCII case, share root/trailing separator, mixed separators, preserved POSIX case/Unicode, dot/parent collapse including a remainder beginning //, /mnt/d mapping and uppercase /MNT nonmapping. Add negative near-host/missing-distro rows proving generic UNC remains generic; keys must also match both built JS dists. Reuse existing childKeys/pythonKeys/powershellKeys and health/preflight fixtures instead of another harness. Add real identity cases where WSL UNC own path and POSIX served path are same, both share-host spellings are same, and case-distinct POSIX remainders are foreign; assert request count and unchanged daemon.json on refusal. Set UTF-8 output explicitly in generated PS key scripts for Unicode rows and preserve existing fixtures' BOM.
implementationPlan.note: Removed WSL todos; added 17 share keys, 7 negative host/missing-distro keys, and 6 real preflight identities per engine with GET count and metadata preservation. PS key fixture explicitly outputs UTF-8 and retains BOM. RED: Linux focused 3 pass/4 assertion failures; native Windows PS5.1+PS7 focused 6 pass/8 assertion failures, all missing WSL normalization. Existing cap/identity assertions untouched. Kept malformed UNC-with-empty-share-and-tail out of this scope (Python ntpath already differs from JS); filed follow-up bug separately. Work is in daemon-assigned worktree; no shared dist or manual landing.

implementationPlan.description: Implement the minimal WSL-share branch in moe-agent.sh probe_daemon_health's comparable() and ps1 Get-MoeComparableProjectPath. After recognizing a Windows-form path and converting backslashes to slashes, match exactly //wsl$/<nonempty distro> or //wsl.localhost/<nonempty distro> with optional remainder; match host ASCII case only (Python re.IGNORECASE|re.ASCII, PS case-sensitive regex with explicit ASCII case pairs or equivalent). Extract remainder, default '/', discard distro, then use existing POSIX collapse and /mnt rules without lowercasing the POSIX tail. In Python force the extracted remainder to a SINGLE leading slash before posixpath.normpath so // remainder doesn't retain POSIX double-slash unlike JS. In PS reset the Windows/UNC classification before existing root/segment handling. Nonmatching drive/generic UNC/POSIX paths keep their current behavior; keep .Equals segment checks and final Ordinal identity equality. Error handling remains existing bounded unknown/foreign paths; no extra IO, no DNS/realpath, no native canonicalization of served values, no daemon deletion/start behavior changes. Maintain wrapper BOM, syntax and grouped-loop/reload fences.
implementationPlan.note: Minimal Windows-form WSL branch strips either ASCII-insensitive host + nonempty distro and reuses POSIX normalization. Python single-prefixes /; PS uses explicit ASCII case pairs and resets windows=false. Generic drive/UNC, HTTP bounds, segment .Equals, final Ordinal equality, lifecycle, BOM and loop/reload fences unchanged. Focused GREEN: Linux 8/8; native Windows PS5.1+PS7 16/16 (no skips). Step-1 out-of-scope malformed UNC follow-up is task-fc31d45081474b03a633bfa1407a4ab1.

implementationPlan.description: Update adjacent launcher comparison comments to state WSL-share stripping and case preservation. In packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts remove ONLY the obsolete two-line caveat saying launchers still treat WSL shares as UNC; keep its runtime and the getDaemonHost comment untouched. Do not edit guest-session persisted ledger keys, JetBrains, or the native-lifecycle fix from task-25ba449a. implementationPlan.note: Adjacent launcher comments now document WSL host/distro stripping and POSIX tail case. Removed only obsolete proxy comparison-contract caveat; runtime and getDaemonHost comment untouched. No guest ledger, JetBrains, or daemon lifecycle edits. Use exact command/exitCode/outputTail for completion. Run the same suite using native Windows Node and Git Bash with both PowerShell5.1 and7 key/identity rows executing, not skipped; its existing parser test must pass and separately assert moe-agent.ps1 starts with EF BB BF. No WSL-share todo remains. New WSL hard assertions must fail with the branch removed from either launcher; existing identity/foreign/cap tests remain unchanged and passing. No full unrelated daemon regression: executable JS unchanged, task25ba449a owns its transport/lifecycle gate.
implementationPlan.note: Exact named gate passed in byte-matched isolated snapshots, with npm ci --prefer-offline + builds in each package/native OS: Linux 23 pass/58 unavailable-PS skips; native Windows Node+GitBash 78 pass/3 existing WSL-only branch skips. PS5.1/PS7 keys, real identities, and parser tests all ran. Both: 0 fail/0 todo, parity PASS. Explicit EFBBBF asserts passed on source and snapshots. Removing Bash WSL branch yields 1 assertion failure; removing PS branch yields 2 (both engines). Windows full gate exposed two fixture issues, fixed within this test file: Python key stdin now binary UTF8 JSON (native redirected stdin was cp1252), and Unicode identity uses WSL UNC as own path because GitBash cygpath must native-resolve own POSIX paths. Strengthened metadata immutability to compare exact PID-substituted fixture bytes. Existing cap/identity assertions unchanged. Linux qualityGate parity+lint also passed.

implementationPlan.description: Final adversarial self-review: test near-host lookalikes, empty distro vs share root, mixed/duplicate separators, '..' at POSIX root, U+00AD/case-distinct tail, /mnt mapping and generic UNC non-regression. Confirm host matching does not case-fold tail or accept Unicode lookalikes, same project no longer refuses but genuinely foreign project still does, original bounded HTTP/error handling and ordinal equality are intact, and no persisted key/lifecycle policy changed. Stay within400 task-owned net lines; fix findings and rerun the named gate before complete_task/QA.
implementationPlan.note: Adversarial self-review complete on scoped diff, +68/-12 (56 net). Pure local normalization adds no shared state/TOCTOU/IO or new cleanup paths. Hard keys cover ASCII mixed hosts, U+017F lookalikes, missing distro vs share root, mixed/duplicate separators, root parents, U+00AD/dotlike tails, POSIX case, /mnt and /MNT; real probes assert one GET and exact unchanged metadata including fixture PID. Ordinal equality, .Equals segments, bounded HTTP/error paths, persisted keys/lifecycle and loop/reload fences remain intact. Final fresh named gate on byte-identical snapshots: Linux 23 pass/58 legitimate unavailable-PS skips; native Windows 78 pass/3 existing WSL-only skips; both 0 fail/0 todo and parity PASS. Both PS parsers executed, EFBBBF preserved, branch-removal mutants killed on Bash and both PS engines. qualityGate parity+lint passed on Linux and Windows. No further findings/source changes.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Small pre-normalization WSL-share branch reuses existing POSIX algorithms. Avoid rewriting all path normalizers or changing local-runner persisted keys. Explicit ASCII matching avoids PS5.1/PS7 Unicode ignore-case surprises.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Bash currently returns ntpath-normalized/lowercased Windows forms before POSIX processing; PS has an ordinal segment collapse and a Windows boolean. Python posixpath.normpath retains exactly two leading slashes, so WSL remainder needs single-leading-slash normalization to match JS. Existing test block has WSL todo rows, built-dist comparison and native PS engines. Proxy utils comment alone is stale after this change. Prior task25ba449a rev2 isolates native lifecycle expected-path normalization; do not copy it into remote transport comparison.
